Base: `f287a370c81b60d24cfaf026cfa04afeb7943bbd`.

The cache wrapper stalled before it produced an artifact. I disabled it for the completed commands.

## Host failures checked on bare main

This headless host provides no GPU adapter to the tests. I ran the same UI command from `crates/ui`
on bare main `f287a370c81b60d24cfaf026cfa04afeb7943bbd`:

`cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-ui --no-fail-fast --lib -- --test-threads=16`

Both trees gave 1,642 passed, seven failed, and eight ignored. The failed tests are identical:

- `egui_app::report_tests::a_kind_button_asks_the_shell_for_the_whole_window`
- `egui_app::report_tests::no_answer_copies_nothing`
- `egui_app::report_tests::the_answer_copies_the_picture_and_says_the_word`
- `egui_app::report_tests::the_door_opens_the_window_and_a_kind_button_files_the_url`
- `egui_app::report_tests::the_picture_is_still_copied_after_the_window_is_closed`
- `egui_app::report_tests::the_title_field_travels_into_the_url`
- `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`

The first six fail with:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
```

The last fails with:

```text
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter: software adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found
```

These are host failures, not PR blockers.
